backup_create.why: cliff gate, not a target: observed ~0.3s local for 10k rows + 5 MiB photos. 30s tolerates 100x runner noise but catches algorithmic regressions (e.g. per-row queries turning the chunked stream quadratic).

backup_verify.why: cliff gate: observed ~0.1s local. Verify must stay a linear streaming pass; anything near 30s means the streaming broke.

backup_restore.why: cliff gate: observed ~0.3s local for the single-transaction replay. Guards the chunked multi-INSERT path, not absolute speed.

diagnostics_collect.why: cliff gate: observed ~0.01s local under 10k-row load. Aggregations must stay index-served COUNT/GROUP queries plus capped log/tail walks.

pmtiles_verify.why: cliff gate: observed <0.01s local on the 2 MiB fixture. Guards the entry/dir caps (DIR_INFLATED_MAX, ENTRIES_MAX) against blowup on hostile files.

installer_min_build.why: cliff gate: observed ~0.05s local including PHP startup. The tokenizer pass is linear; 30s catches pathological backtracking in the quote-aware strip.
